situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Put focus on SL-110, the last card of Backlog, and press Delete.
question: Which part has focus, and is a delete request sent at this moment?
answer: Focus is on SL-109, the card above (there is no next card). No delete request is sent yet.
